name.description: the group name, shown as the link text, a name that ends with the city nests the city under the rest of the name on the page

url.description: the group page, not an event page

tool.description: where the group organizes, a lowercase hostname, eg meetup.com

city.description: city as the group names it

region.description: optional ISO 3166-2 code, eg US-CA, stored for filtering, not shown

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, eg US, stored for filtering, not shown

lat.description: venue latitude, or the city center when the venue moves

lng.description: venue longitude, or the city center when the venue moves
